headline: House passes mining legislation as California special election fills 14th District seat!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate was not in session on Wednesday, September 2. The chamber stands adjourned and will reconvene Friday for a pro forma session.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House swore in new representative Aisha Wahab from California's 14th District following her special election victory on August 18. The chamber voted on two measures: rejecting a constitutional amendment to fix Supreme Court size at nine justices (212-206), and passing the Protecting Domestic Mining Act (218-201).
